description:
Comment style: plain present-tense facts, no ticket numbers. Scope is runtime/src (the compiler's 1,154 hits under src are fz-n8q). Census at b55d0e3ff: 110 comment lines under runtime/src cite ticket ids (grep -rnE '//.*(\bfz-[a-z0-9]{2,4}(\.[0-9]+)*\b|\bvrx\.)' runtime/src): ir_runtime.rs 28, any_value.rs 15 (vrx.0.2 on TAG_LIST/TAG_MAP/TAG_STRUCT, fz-yan.1 on TAG_SPECIAL and reserved atom ids, fz-s9y.2 on EMPTY_LIST_BITS, vrx.A.1 on ListCons), procbin.rs 8 (incl. fz-5xp.55 on ProcBin), process.rs 6, heap/imp.rs 6, scheduler_hooks.rs 5, heap/heap_test.rs 5, aot_shim.rs 5, resource.rs 4, procbin_test.rs 4, ir_runtime_test.rs 4, and 1-3 each in 12 more files.

Done when: the census is recorded in the commit; each hit is rewritten to the fact it was carrying, or deleted when the code already says it; the grep over comments under runtime/src returns nothing. Identifiers, test names and fixture data that contain ids are reported, not renamed. Done when also: full gate green (cargo fmt --all -- --check; cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings; cargo test --workspace --all-targets --no-fail-fast -- --test-threads=1; cargo test --workspace --doc); no pin or golden moves; commit in Why / What changed / Verification form; no co-author trailer, no attribution line.
title: Runtime comments state facts, not ticket numbers
